_note: Promotion card prices for the estimate calculator on promo.niveshsahayak.in (engine/promo.js). Change the numbers, rebuild promo, publish. cpm = rupees per 1,000 card views. views_per_day = how many card views each place can give in a day (update from Cloudflare Web Analytics now and then). If you change cpm, place mult, india_extra or min_total, also change the same numbers in the questions on sites/promo/pages/index.html.
